name: @local/dsh-escape-pod
description: The escape pod (逃生舱) as a standalone component: commands are owned by a detached pod process that survives DSH restarts, exposed as the pod_run / pod_exec / pod_output / pod_kill / pod_freeze / pod_status / pod_shell tools. Commands follow the calling session's DSH file policy (read-only / workspace-write / danger-full-access), and a narrower session can ask for a wider mode through the real DSH approval dialog for that one call. pod_shell detects the machine's PowerShell / bash / cmd paths and versions, lets the AI pick one per session (automatic fallback to the settings default, then to auto-detection), and the settings page stores defaults plus freeze mode (freeze running commands 10s after DSH disappears, thaw on reconnect, regeneration episodes, self-destruct) and a hold-to-confirm button that kills the pod's jobs and shuts the pod down.

scripts.test: node test/escape-pod-shell.test.mjs && node test/pod-settings.test.mjs && node test/shells.test.mjs && node test/pod-shell-tool.test.mjs && node test/pod-policy.test.mjs && node test/pod-freeze-policy.test.mjs
